title: Kelowna Downtown Marina
specs: Located in downtown Kelowna with easy access to city
Okanagan Lake is 135 km long, max depth 232 m
Minimum age 19 for most rentals, 21 for tournament and wakeboard boats
Credit card for pre-authorization deposit required
Renter must be sole driver of boat
No alcohol or drugs allowed before or while driving boat
Pontoon boat seats up to 16 passengers
No limit on number of drivers; 2 drivers included, $15 per additional driver per rental

services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: Dying to try wakesurfing, wakeboarding, waterskiing, or tubing? We've got you covered. Our fleet of boat rentals in Kelowna is the perfect way to explore Okanagan Lake. From MasterCraft wakesurf and wakeboard boats to Chaparral and Bayliner bowriders, Cobalt and Regal luxury performance boats, Yamaha Waverunners, and kayaks and paddleboards, Kelowna Downtown Marina can get you on the lake affordably and in style. Take a cruise through our boats for rent - there is something for everyone, every family, every sun-lover. Compact and stylish, the Bayliner Element M15 is an easy-to-operate…View

includes: Temporary boater's license supplied with rental
Full tank of fuel at rental start
gap: Exact duration options and prices for each boat type not fully detailed
blurb: Guests rent various boats and Jet-Skis on Okanagan Lake. Rentals include a temporary boater's license and safety orientation. Moorage slips are available for short term, overnight, and seasonal use with security on site.
extraNote: Cancellations must be made at least 48 hours in advance · Pre-authorization deposit $1000 for regular boats, $2500 for tournament boats, $250 for kayaks/paddleboards · Fuel cost charged on return for amount used · No refund if no-show; charged full rental cost · No overnight sleeping on boats at moorage · Boating allowed in most weather except thunder and lightning · Kelowna Downtown Marina docks
